title: Schreyer resolution of modules over formal power series
summary: Standard bases of modules over algebras of formal power series play the same role as Gröbner bases of modules over polynomial algebras. In this article, we first prove the analogue of the diamond lemma for modules over formal power series; it characterises standard bases in terms of unique remainders and standard representations. Then, using standard representations, we provide a method to construct a standard basis of the module of syzygies of a standard basis.
